skill.name: python-executor
skill.description: Execute Python scripts through the inference.sh sandbox with common data, web, media, document, and 3D libraries.
skill.summary: Run Python snippets in an inference.sh sandbox for analysis, automation, and file generation.
skill.author: skillssh

security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick findings are false positives from fenced examples and package names. Several infsh app run examples are intentional external command execution, and the skill has real network-capable examples. No prompt injection evidence was found.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users that submitted code and data are sent to inference.sh, and require confirmation before running generated scripts.
Add guidance to use only authorized URLs, avoid private endpoints, and follow site terms when scraping.
Tell users to verify source repositories and pin trusted versions before running npx skills add commands.
Document filesystem isolation, retention, network policy, timeout behavior, and whether submitted data is stored.

content.user_title: Run Python Code in a Sandbox
content.value_statement: Agents often need Python execution without managing local packages. This skill runs scripts through inference.sh with common data, web, media, and document libraries.
actual_capabilities: Runs Python 3.10 code with infsh app run infsh/python-executor.
Supports timeout, capture_output, and working_dir input settings.
Uses preinstalled libraries for data, plotting, image, video, PDF, and 3D tasks.
Returns files saved under outputs, including charts, CSV files, videos, and 3D models.
Provides 8GB default memory and a 16GB high_memory variant.
Includes examples for web scraping, API calls, media creation, and file export.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and login before use.
Runs CPU-only and does not include GPU or ML workloads.
Execution is non-interactive, so visual output must be saved to files.
Network code can contact websites or APIs, so users must manage permissions and privacy.

use_cases.title: Analyze Small Datasets
use_cases.description: Summarize and visualize CSV or table data without preparing a local Python environment.

use_cases.title: Prototype Automation Scripts
use_cases.description: Test API calls, transformations, and file generation through a managed Python runtime.

use_cases.title: Generate Operational Assets
use_cases.description: Create charts, PDFs, images, short videos, or converted files for repeatable content tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Use python-executor to run a short Python calculation and show the printed result. Keep the default timeout.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Use python-executor to load my CSV, summarize numeric columns, and save one clear chart in outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use python-executor to create an image or short video from my requirements, then return the output filename.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Report Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use python-executor to fetch approved API data, transform it with pandas, create a PDF summary, and return all files.

output_examples.input: Create a bar chart from a small sales table and save it as a file.
output_examples.output: A chart file is returned from the outputs folder, with a short note naming the file.

output_examples.input: Fetch public profile data from an approved API and summarize key fields.
output: The response includes a concise summary of the public data.
Any requested report file is returned from outputs.

output_examples.input: Convert a simple 3D object into an exportable model file.
output_examples.output: A model file is returned from outputs, along with basic size and geometry notes.

best_practices: Review generated code before execution, especially network and file operations.
Use the shortest practical timeout and choose high_memory only for large jobs.
Save durable results under outputs so the skill can return the files.
anti_patterns: Do not submit secrets, access tokens, or private datasets without approval for inference.sh processing.
Do not scrape websites without permission or required compliance checks.
Do not rely on interactive windows, prompts, or GUI displays.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs Python scripts through the inference.sh python-executor app and returns text or generated files.

faq.question: Does it run on my local Python install?
faq.answer: No. It uses the infsh CLI to run an inference.sh app, not your local Python interpreter.

faq.question: Which libraries are available?
faq.answer: It lists common libraries for data analysis, plotting, web scraping, images, video, PDFs, and 3D processing.

faq.question: Can it create files?
faq.answer: Yes. Files saved under outputs are automatically detected and returned by the app.

faq.question: Does it support GPU workloads?
faq.answer: No. The documented environment is CPU-only and points users to dedicated AI apps for those workloads.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Treat submitted code and data as sent to an external service. Use only data approved for that environment.
